why: State is where 2.x apps wrote the most glue: a filter, a tab, a form draft or a live query that does not bind to one store field turns into useState, useEffect and hand-written URL sync in every app. The owner asked for repeated improvement cycles on states and stores, and docs/v3/CYCLES.md is the protocol. Cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/state-1.md) found 4 P1 and 11 P2; this cycle rebuilds on the fixes.
what: Cycle 2 of the state, stores and controls area: build, measure, log, file. Protocol: docs/v3/CYCLES.md.
owns: apps/playground/src/** (the cycle build only: new files plus nav registration)
change: Build one realistic data page in the playground: a FilterSet with a range, a multi-select, a search and a toggle, all in the URL; ViewTabs switching between a table and a chart of the same query; a live query that refreshes on an interval and through a bound invalidation; a connection indicator; a row that opens an edit form with a draft, validation, a submit helper and a FormFooter. Then do what users do: reload mid-edit, share the URL, go back and forward, reset the filters, fail the submit, go offline. Count: every useState, useEffect or manual URL read the app wrote for state the kit should own; every place two sources of truth disagree after one of those actions; and lines of glue between a store field and a control. Build it fresh in apps/playground/src/cycle/state-2/ on route /cycle-state-2, leave cycle 1's build as it is, and compare the numbers with cycle 1's in a trend table.
commits: Playground build in its own commit (feat:), findings and plan rows in a docs: commit. No package commit.
proof: docs/v3/cycles/state-2.md with the sha, the numbers, the action-by-action results and the findings table.
acceptance: docs/v3/cycles/state-2.md exists, names the master sha, and has every field from CYCLES.md step 5 for each finding

The file has a table with one row per user action from the change (reload, share, back/forward, reset, failed submit, offline), each showing the expected result, the actual result and a finding id where they differ
The build imports basalt-ui only through published subpaths, and every workaround carries a `cycle-state-2:` comment
Every P1 has its own plan row with a brief; the P2s are grouped one row per class; or the file states convergence
If the cycle did not converge, a v3-cycle-state-3 row exists after every fix row
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD lists nothing under packages/basalt-ui/
out_of_scope: Fixing any finding in this PR; createSyncedState transports beyond the in-memory one.
